title: Quotient
summary: QUO'TIENT, noun [Latin quoties, how often.] In arithmetic, the number resulting from the division of one number by another, and showing how often a less number is contained in a greater. Thus 3)12(4.

inlines.v: QUO'TIENT, noun [Latin quoties, how often.] In arithmetic, the number resulting from the division of one number by another, and showing how often a less number is contained in a greater. Thus 3)12(4. Here 4 is the quotient showing that 3 is contained 4 times in 12. Or quotient is an expression denoting a certain part of a unit; as 3/4.
